content.thinking: Why invalid? Work count 4*20000=80000 okay, traffic per data frame: data count each charges4*count*(58+4D); four rank events => 16*20000*4154=1.329GB >256MB. Need fewer D or count. Static traffic cap limits total input bytes 4x = ~256MB, so at D1024 each frame 4154, total frames across data/train <= ~16100. For 1m packets D must small, e.g. D=1 frame62 => total bytes ~62MB for1m? 4*1m*62=248MB near cap. So worst payload size vs count constrained: roughly work*frame_size limited ~64MB actual? Since traffic =4*frame bytes ≤256MB => total ingress bytes ≤64MB. Ah static traffic bounds total input wire bytes plus overhead. So Python expansion only up to64MB of frames if all data. 1m packets D=1 -> total64MB raw, but Python per-packet overhead for1m. Let's benchmark 100k D1.
